messages:
alex_p: Heads up — prepping QBR materials for partner ops next month. Need to localize the scorecard + MDF runway for APAC partners and adjust a few metrics for marketplace vs SI integrations. Quick sync?
priya: SG. When you say 'localize' — do you mean currency conversions, metric thresholds, language, or all of the above?
ben: I'd focus on currency + threshold adjustments first. Also propose adding a simple SI health metric (onboarding velocity). :thinking_face: 
emily: Agree on onboarding velocity. From the marketplace side we should surface: daily installs, conversion rate (trial->paid), and avg trial minutes. Also want a clear "integration completion" metric for SIs.
marco: If we add integration completion we need a concise definition. Proposal: integration_complete = CI pipeline green + sample deploy in staging + docs link published. That keeps it binary and auditable. Thoughts?
alex_p: That definition works. Draft metric list for the QBR (short): `marketplace_installs`, `marketplace_conversion_pct`, `si_integration_pct`, `mau_from_partners`, `mdf_spend_pct_used` — plus regional currency normalized ARR. Can someone pick up localization for APAC currencies (JPY/CNY/AUD)?
priya: I can own JPY + APAC currency conversion mapping. Will need a mapping table from finance for FX rates and preferred presentation (local vs USD). @ben can you confirm the MDF runway buckets we should show (3/6/12 mo)?
ben: Current default is 6-mo runway in reporting. For APAC pilot I'd recommend showing both 6-mo and 9-mo scenarios to the field. I'll check with finance and push the 9-mo ask. :white_check_mark:
partner_bot: Reminder: QBR template v2 uploaded -> https://drive.redwood/qbr-templates (deck v2)
emily: Also we should tweak tier promotion thresholds for APAC SIs — maturity skew means lowering min-rev requirement for pilot tier. Suggest lowering min-revenue requirement to 50k (local) for the pilot cohort.
marco: +1. For scorecard weighting I propose: marketplace health 30%, SI integrations 25%, MDF utilization 15%, customer references 20%, enablement activity 10%. Keeps focus on ops + growth.
alex_p: Love it. Let's lock this by EOD Friday so sales & AMs get a week to prep. Action items: Priya (currency mapping + slide), Ben (MDF runway ask & numbers), Marco (write integration completion checklist + sample criteria), Emily (update QBR deck with new weights & marketplace metrics). I'll consolidate and circulate the draft. :point_right:
priya: Ack. I'll also add localization notes for time zones on presentation windows. Creating a small table for slide.
ben: I'll draft the finance note and share numbers by tomorrow noon PT.
partner_bot: Event created: "Partner QBR localization review" — 30m review tomorrow 10:00 PT. Attendees: alex_p, priya, ben, emily, marco.
alex_p: Thanks team. If anyone finds a blocker ping me in thread or drop in the 10am review.
